text:
Let him who has lost so much lose no more;
love, let what I have suffered suffice.
Let my having once tried to defend myself
against your will now be my aid.

Your temple and its walls I dressed
with garments drenched by rain, adorned
as one who has escaped at last,
free from the storm he lived through.

I had sworn never again, by my own will,
to enter any danger like that one.
The oath was vain.

But I cannot save myself from what comes;
I do not break my promise here:
this danger is unlike the others, beyond my hand.

translation.title: Let him who has lost so much lose no more
